name: sparkline
title: Sparkline
description: A trend as one fine line, small enough for a sentence, a row or a stat.
use: The shape of a series where its words already stand: beside a figure in a stat, in a column of a table, inside a sentence. It shows which way something went and how steadily, not the values: write the values beside it, or name the trend in its aria-label.

instead.when: The values themselves are read and compared, with their names
Each step is a state, such as up or down, not an amount
It is one figure and how it moved, with no history to draw
There are many small numbers and the pattern of the whole field matters

platform.feature: CSS mask-image on an SVG shape, which fades the area out toward its foot
platform.fallback: The area under the line is an even tint

classes.name: sparkline
classes.description: The box the drawing stretches to: 4em wide and .75em tall, standing on the middle of a capital. Give it role="img" and an aria-label that names the trend, or aria-hidden="true" when the numbers stand beside it

classes.name: sparkline-success
classes.description: The success ink, for a trend that went well; the words beside it say so too

classes.name: sparkline-warning
classes.description: The warning ink, for a trend to watch; the words beside it say so too

classes.name: sparkline-danger
classes.description: The danger ink, for a trend that went badly; the words beside it say so too

classes.name: sparkline-plot
classes.description: The drawing: an SVG with viewBox="0 0 100 100" and preserveAspectRatio="none", stretched to the sparkline's box. Strokes may stand past its edge

classes.name: sparkline-line
classes.description: The trend: a 1.5px line in the ink of the text around it, with round joins and ends, that keeps its width however the drawing stretches

classes.name: sparkline-area
classes.description: The area under the line: the same points closed along the foot, as a tint of the ink that fades out downward. Put it before the line

classes.name: sparkline-baseline
classes.description: A dotted hairline for a baseline, an average or a target, quieter than the line

classes.name: sparkline-dot
classes.description: The latest value: a 5px dot placed by --x and --y, a perfect circle however the drawing stretches, cut out of the line by a ring of the surface behind it

properties.name: --sparkline-width
properties.description: Width of the sparkline; 4em unless set. It may be set on a container, such as a table, to size every sparkline in it

properties.name: --sparkline-height
properties.description: Height of the sparkline; .75em unless set, about the height of a capital. It may be set on a container too

properties.name: --sparkline-dot
properties.description: Size of the dot at the latest value

properties.name: --x
properties.description: Where the dot stands across, from 0 to 100: the x of the last point in the drawing

properties.name: --y
properties.description: Where the dot stands down, from 0 at the top to 100 at the foot: the y of the last point in the drawing
